system.description:
Offer a (rigged) game of skill to a PC. The PC can wager coins (up to a bag) and make an appropriate action roll, with the following results:

  • Critical Success: Perfect score. The carnie begrudgingly hands over double the PC's wager, but bans them from further games.

  • Success with Hope: Winning score. The carnie gives the PC returns their wager plus an extra half, and hypes them up to keep playing.

  • Success with Fear: Should have won, but the game was rigged. The carnie says better luck next time.

  • Failure with Hope: Almost a win. The carnie eggs on the PC and returns half their wager to tempt them to keep playing.

  • Failure with Fear: Total loss. The carnie offers the game to another PC.

What games are setup at the carnival? What skills do they test, and how are they rigged?
